title: Levoit Top Fill Humidifiers for Bedroom, 2.5L Tank for Large Room, Quiet Cool Mist
features: Fast Humidification All Night: Runs for up to 25 hours on low thanks to its large 2.5 liter capacity. The soothing moisture helps quickly relieve congestion and dry throat.
Easy Top-Fill Design: Easy top-fill design—no need to turn the water tank over or spill water. Just one step to remove the cover and fill the tank.
Much Easier for Cleaning: Easily clean the inside of the tank through its big opening. Detachable designs leave no hard-to-reach corners when cleaning.
No Disturbance When Sleeping: Noise level as low as 25dB and all lights off. Perfect humidifier for bedrooms and baby nurseries.
Customize Your Mist: Customize mist output with one knob and adjust direction freely with the 360 degree nozzle.
Auto Shut-Off for Safety: Automatically stops when the water tank is empty or removed from the base, preventing overheating or running dry.
